$comment: Canonical PrivateFPC deployment descriptor — mirrors ecosystem-tooling's canonical-deployment.json at tag v5.0.1 (the publisher of @alejoamiras/aztec-fee-payment), extended with the installed artifact's digest, the target-network identity pins, and the digest-keyed node-compat map. The address is derived from compiled bytecode + salt and is ONLY valid for this exact aztecVersion + artifact — depositing Fee Juice to a stale address is UNRECOVERABLE. The canonical salt is a fixed project constant from 5.0.0 onward; rc-era pins used operator-local salts and are dead. Machine-asserted by private-fuel.test.ts (derivation + digest + compat coherence) and consumed by check-fpc-version.ts (compat-gated version + digest + network-identity + live-class gate, --mode predeploy|require-deployed).

network.$comment: Hard identity pins for the ONE network this descriptor deploys to (Sepolia-anchored v5 testnet, verified live 2026-07-18). A gate run against any other network is a wrong-network operator error, not a compat question.

compatibleNodeVersions.$comment: HUMAN-CURATED, digest-keyed: node versions this exact artifact (by sha256) may be deployed/run against. 5.0.1 aztec-nr/js are protocol-compatible with the live 5.0.0 node (owner ruling, aztec-5.0.1-line plan); a new artifact digest REQUIRES a fresh entry — the gate fails closed on a missing key.
